note: Verification ladder catalog (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md v3.6 + v4.6). v4: every module lists the claim kinds it `backs`; it is offered for a claim only if it backs that claim's kind and its `needs` are met, and it moves only those claims' scores (witness_review with backsTargetedOnly: only claims whose requirements an answered witness request targeted). Clients show these offers and previews; only the runLadderModule Cloud Function runs a module, spends credits and recomputes the score. Pass: p' = p + s*(1-p). Fail: p' = p*(1-s). Each module runs at most once per Moment, in any order. Credits are spent whether it passes or fails.

modules.title: Second opinion
modules.blurb: A stricter cloud model re-examines every proof frame.

modules.title: Place & time check
modules.blurb: GPS, clock and daylight are checked against the claim and the light in the frames.

modules.blurb: Did every answer actually show what the witness asked for?

modules.title: Count & measure
modules.blurb: Sensors and frames are used to count and measure the claimed numbers.

modules.blurb: A person reviews the full evidence. Coming soon.

needs.frames: at least one proof frame in the chain
needs.gps: at least one GPS sample in the chain
needs.witness_answered: at least one witness_answer event in the chain
needs.quantities: v4 seals: a server claim (moments/{id}.claims) of kind count or measure; v3 seals: intention.quantities has at least one entry
needs.video: a `video` event in the chain AND the clip uploaded to Storage at clips/{uid}/{momentId}/{sha256}.{mp4|mov|webm} (v4: uploaded at submit; the function re-hashes it)
